setting.help: Where the product categories live. Kiosk fills the pane with picture tiles and opens one category's products in a popup; the dropdown frees the whole pane for products; tiles is Odoo's core behaviour with one tap per category.
The category the kiosk 'Add on' button lists. Leave empty to hide it.
Print a price on every product card. Odoo core shows none.
Lower bound in pixels for a product card. The grid fits as many columns as the screen allows. 150 gives about 5 columns at 1280px wide and 4 at 1024px.
In Odoo 19 the (...) popup is the only route to 'Cancel Order', 'Pricelist' and 'Refund' from this screen.
